title: ZONE A GENERAL DISTRICT REGULATIONS
previewText: Zone A is designed generally to provide for residential development with ancillary retail and service uses, and transient hotels as permitted pursuant to Section 84-12. Zone A is divided into six subzones: A-1, A-2, A-3, A-4, A-5 and A-6. The location and boundaries of the subzones are shown in Appendices 2 and 3 of this Chapter.
